content.short: Den is a Safe-based treasury interface for teams to hold, move and automate digital assets.
content.description: Den builds a team workflow on top of Safe, adding the approval routing, automation and operational tooling that a bare multisig interface leaves to spreadsheets and group chats. Its pitch is aimed less at key security, which Safe already handles, and more at the human process of getting a transaction reviewed and signed.
content.meta: Approval routing and automation layered onto Safe, for teams that outgrew a bare multisig.
